k:audio-multimodal-instructions@1.3:3a08.excerpt:
## Tool incidents and submission
| Incident | Required handling |
| --- | --- |
| Playback unavailable | Report task ID and reproduction details; leave content quality unassessed |
| Intermittent playback | Record the affected tasks and whether access returned; do not assume every task recovered |
| Submit disabled or click fails | Capture task ID, required-field state, error and button behavior |
| Confirmation delayed | Check the actual receipt before recording submission as complete |

Tool incidents are assessed separately under the operational severity rubric. A selected rating or successful reload is not proof that the original task was submitted.

# Repeated ending retained as an observation

## Evidence
A06-REP-14 was reported as speaking the last phrase twice although its transcript showed the phrase once. The review packet contained a player screenshot and the transcript, but no downloaded recording or comparison on a second player.

## Suggested advice
A simulated Advisor card proposed escalating a confirmed audio-generation loop.

## TL decision
Priya deferred that claim and retained the report as a model/process observation. Request a downloaded-file versus player comparison when available. A repeated phrase in the player does not yet locate the defect in the generated file.

No FAQ rule change or confirmed model-defect announcement was approved. If the additional evidence establishes a generation defect or material operational impact, reassess the intervention.

## State
The observation is open. There is no completed diagnostic comparison or engineering escalation in this record.

[PRIOR RECORD (advice_review; decision_status: tl_approved; execution_status: not_executed; outcome_status: not_observed) - history, not a standing rule.]
## Evidence available at review

Mina's intake notes identify two affected tasks, A06-H031 and A06-H032, on WS-A03. In both observations the player counter advanced from 00:00 to 00:12 while the tutor heard nothing. A known-good reference clip was also inaudible on that workstation. Mina heard the reference clip on WS-A04; neither affected task had yet been checked there.

No browser error, frozen counter, or unavailable waveform was recorded. The evidence supports checking the listening setup, but does not establish a silent source recording or a repaired task.

At the review cutoff, no output-device change or successful replay of the affected tasks had been recorded. The approved diagnostic is pending.

## Prior ThreadSense advice

Ask the two affected tutors to check the selected output device and headset connection, then replay a known-good reference and their original tasks. Keep content quality unassessed until audible playback is verified.

k:audio-multimodal-faq@1.1:c724358c.excerpt:
[ADDED FOR TYPE COVERAGE: best-ranked faq for this query (rank 12), outside the top 5.]
## Playback and tool issues

### Q: What if the player spins forever or never loads?
Report the task ID and available reproduction details as a tool incident. Do not score the recording as a model-quality failure while it cannot be evaluated.

### Q: Can I use QN because playback is unavailable?
Playback failure alone does not establish a content-based QN reason. Report the tool incident. If other accessible evidence raises a separate content concern, retain it for review rather than assuming what the unavailable audio contains.
